mapper.select: SELECT business_no FROM tc_return_receipt WHERE business_no=#{number} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tc_return_receipt(tenant_id,return_no,business_no,order_id,order_item_id,source_actor_key,source_request_id,warehouse_id,received_quantity,restock_quantity,inspection_ref,request_hash,created_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{number},#{businessNo},#{order},#{item},#{actor},#{event},#{warehouse},#{received},#{saleable},#{evidence},#{hash},#{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT return_no,request_hash FROM tc_return_receipt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND source_actor_key=#{actor} AND source_request_id=#{event} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_order_item SET returned_quantity=returned_quantity+#{received},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} AND id=#{item} AND stock_type='PHYSICAL' AND quantity-returned_quantity>=#{received}
